sentences.text: DATE : 16.04.2024 Heard learned Advocate for the cross objector learned AGP for respondent Nos.1 and 2 and learned Advocate for respondent Nos.3 and 4.
2. This is an application for condonation of 648 days delay caused in filing cross objection.
The reasons have been stated in the application.

3. In view of the reasons, the application is allowed subject to condition that cross objector herein shall not be entitled to get any statutory benefits, including the 2 19 fa 176.22.odt.
interest payable under the Land Acquisition Act on the enhanced amount of compensation for the delayed period, in case the cross objection is allowed.
4. Delay of 648 days caused in filing cross objection stands condoned.
